It's great to see my former colleague and friend David Patterson joining @LaudeInstitute!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Jeff Dean megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Laude Institute (@LaudeInstitute); megjelent: 2026-11-19T20:42:30+00:00; link: https://x.com/LaudeInstitute/status/2123517295402287577; média: nincs média]
Dave Patterson has a habit of giving bad advice. His latest, How to Earn a Bad Obituary, explains why he's joining @LaudeInstitute as a Member of Technical Staff: to work for the public good with all the urgency of a startup.

First on his to-do list: leading our next batch of Moonshots! 🌕

More good (bad) advice from Dave: http://laude.org/updates/how-to-earn-a-bad-obituary
